values.binNote: The wiki's Two-Stack value is one-stack MarkDamage/MarkRatio multiplied by 2 stacks and by (1 + TwoMarkBonusPercent/100 = 1.2). No bin calculation performs this multiplication (LockeQ#NailDamage only computes the single-stack case); the final numbers (e.g. 43.2, coef 0.6) are a derived combination of LockeQ.MarkDamage, LockeQ.MarkRatio and LockeQ.TwoMarkBonusPercent, not a literal bin row.

The wiki's Three-Stack value is one-stack MarkDamage/MarkRatio multiplied by 3 stacks and by (1 + ThreeMarkBonusPercent/100 = 1.4). No bin calculation performs this multiplication (LockeQ#NailDamage only computes the single-stack case); the final numbers (e.g. 75.6, coef 1.05) are a derived combination of LockeQ.MarkDamage, LockeQ.MarkRatio and LockeQ.ThreeMarkBonusPercent, not a literal bin row.

mechanics.claim: Ritual Nails can be recast up to twice more within 4 seconds of the first cast at no additional cost, with a fixed 0.5-second cooldown between casts regardless of ability haste.
mechanics.quote: ''Ritual Nails'' can be recast twice more within 4 seconds of the activation at no additional cost, with a {{fd|0.5}}-second {{tt|static cooldown|Unaffected by ability haste}} between casts.

mechanics.claim: For each recast not used when the window ends, a percentage of the ability's cooldown and mana cost is refunded (up to double that percentage for two unused recasts).
mechanics.quote: For each recast not used when ''Ritual Nails'' ends, {{pp|20 to 35|key=%}} of the ability's {{sti|cooldown}} and {{sti|{{as|mana}}}} cost is refunded, up to a {{pp|20*2 to 35*2|key=%}} refund for two remaining recasts.

mechanics.claim: Locke's next damaging basic attack or Ashen Pursuit against a target with Soul Nails stacks consumes all stacks to deal bonus magic damage scaling with the number of stacks consumed.
mechanics.quote: '''Locke's''' next damaging {{tip|basic attack}} or ''{{ai|Ashen Pursuit|Locke}}'' against an enemy with ''Soul Nails'' stacks consumes them all to deal {{as|'''bonus''' magic damage}} based on the amount of stacks.

mechanics.claim: The nail missile deals area damage while the stack-consumption bonus damage is a separate spell-damage instance.
mechanics.quote: Applies {{tip|area damage}} for the nail missile and deals {{tip|spell damage}} for the stack consumption.

mechanics.claim: Spell shield blocks the nail missile but does not block the stack-consumption bonus damage.
mechanics.quote: {{tip|Spell shield}} will block the nail missile but not the stack consumption.

mechanics.claim: Soul Nails stacks are not consumed if the triggering basic attack is dodged, blocked, or missed while Locke is blinded.
mechanics.quote: The stacks will not be consumed if the triggering basic attack is {{tip|dodge|dodged}}, {{tip|block|blocked}}, or missed while '''Locke''' is {{tip|blind|blinded}}.
